# Describe intentional submit fallthrough beside the shared transition

The submit case comments that it falls through to handle the event like forward. The form uses type=submit for the hidden submit action while unrelated actions use type=button. In this controller, keep the fallthrough reason at the switch boundary and name event cases by their actual route. This is a scoped manual syntax recommendation that makes the shared behavior reviewable; it is not a general requirement to use switch fallthrough in event handlers. These conclusions come from static source inspection. No runtime test or accessibility session was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Account Hub submit handler syntax.
